title: situation.pierpont_elected.title

gate.none: Civil organisation and correspondence only; no secession-cause claim, slavery policy, security order or protected-population effect.

citations.at: p. 6, section 1 directs appointment of a governor by the convention; WHEELING-JOURNAL-1861 pp. 27-28 records election and oath on 20 June; [I] retain one day after the ordinance if delayed

namedOnly: The election and oath as the convention records them, not a quotation or an act by the holder of a pack post. No governor post is opened or filled by this report.
